Hi Liam,

Appreciate you sending those over — that gets us most of the way there. Two asks so we can move to PO issuance next week: 

1) Additional Insured Endorsement: We need the insurer to endorse Redwood Inference LLC as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy. I attached a short sample endorsement (redwood_endorsement_sample.pdf) that captures the wording our procurement team typically accepts.

2) Waiver of Subrogation: We prefer a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law. If your carrier cannot provide this, please let us know the reason and any alternatives (e.g., endorsement pending approval).

3) Billing / Remit: Please confirm vendor legal name for PO, remit-to address, and preferred invoice email. Our finance team (cc'd when needed) uses PO numbers in the form RWI-<four digits>.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Marissa to keep procurement and supplier onboarding in the loop. Once we have the additional insured endorsement (or a timeline from your broker), Kimberly will scope the PO and we can issue within 3 business days.

Best,
Rohan Mehta

Subject: Re: Onboarding docs for vendor setup / COI and W-9 attached

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A few procurement specifics to confirm so we can finalize the PO: 

1) Waiver of Subrogation: Redwood requires waiver of subrogation for General Liability only; we do not require waiver across workers' comp unless jurisdiction requires it. Please confirm that the broker can include GL waiver.

2) Additional Insured: The Additional Insured endorsement should name exactly: "Redwood Inference LLC, its officers, directors, employees and agents." Please use that phrasing.

3) Policy Limits: Your COI shows acceptable limits; procurement will flag only if limits change.

4) PO / Remit: We'll issue the PO to: "Aurelius Security Inc." with EIN 27-4448821 and remit-to address provided. Our AP prefers invoices via AP email (ap@aureliussecurity.com) and accepts PDF invoices attached to invoices@redwood-inference.com. 

5) Required docs to attach to the PO record: executed COI, endorsement pdf, and W-9. Once your broker uploads the executed endorsement we can complete the PO and send the PO number (target: 2 business days after receipt).

Please reply to confirm GL waiver and that the endorsement language will match the exact additional insured phrasing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com
